title: Sopa de gato
lead:
{{short description|Thick soup from southern Spain}}
'''''Sopa de gato''''' (in [[English language|English]]: 'cat soup') is a simple soup typical of the classic cuisine of southern Spain. It is a very thick ''sopa'' (soup), typically made from water, bread, oil, garlic and salt, and served hot.<ref>Neuman, Henry; Baretti, Giuseppe Marco Antonio (1837). [https://books.google.com/books?id=H3otAAAAYAAJ&pg=PA777 ''Neuman and Baretti's Dictionary of the Spanish and English Languages: Spanish and English'']. Longman. p. 777.</ref> It is a suitable dish for the winter months.
